definitions.gloss: considerably; very much; really; to a great degree
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that something is extreme or significant in degree. Indicates that the speaker considers the amount, extent, or intensity to be notable.

definitions.gloss: almost; very nearly; on the verge of
definitions.explanation: Indicates that the speaker nearly did something or came very close to a certain action or state. Often used with ～しようかと{思|おも}った (I almost did...).

examples.japanese: よっぽど⟦{疲|つか}れていた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧んだ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You must have been really tired.

examples.japanese: ⟦こっち→こっち：02903_kocchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よっぽど⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
よっぽど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧、⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}えない→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Unless something really serious happens, I won't change the plan.

examples.japanese: よっぽど⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
あまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧で、よっぽど⟦{怒|おこ}ろう→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: It was so rude that I very nearly got angry.

examples.japanese: よっぽど⟦{言|い}おう→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧おいた。
examples.english: I almost said something, but decided against it.

notes:
A colloquial variant of よほど. Both forms are widely used, but よっぽど is more common in casual spoken Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- よっぽど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと — something really serious
- よっぽど〜⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧ — I almost did...
- よっぽど〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧ — ... is far better

USAGE:
In sense 1, よっぽど emphasizes degree and is often used in comparisons (よっぽど⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧, よっぽど⟦まし→まし：11145_mashi⟧). The phrase よっぽど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧ is a very common set expression meaning 'unless something extraordinary happens.' In sense 2, it expresses that the speaker was on the verge of doing something but held back.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- よほど — considerably (the standard/slightly more formal form of the same word)
- ⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧ — considerably, fairly (more neutral; よっぽど carries stronger emphasis and emotion)
- ずいぶん — quite, considerably (similar emphasis but used differently in comparisons)
